description: Build a tower-side Python script (target environment: Windows tower 192.168.86.25 - NOT ZoComputer) that drives Selenium against the live Sentinel UI at https://zo-sentinel-ui-robinc.zocomputer.io and writes a JSON probe report to the shared probes folder. On invocation the script: (1) starts a headless Chrome via selenium.webdriver.Chrome with options.add_argument('--headless=new'), '--no-sandbox', '--disable-dev-shm-usage', window-size 1440x900; (2) GETs the root path with a 30s page-load timeout; (3) records http_status using requests.head separately (selenium does not expose status cleanly); (4) records the 5 security-header values (Strict-Transport-Security, Content-Security-Policy, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy) - missing keys reported as null; (5) GETs /openapi.json without auth via requests.get and records status_code; (6) takes a full-page screenshot saved alongside the JSON as ui_probe_<ts>.png; (7) measures DOMContentLoaded via driver.execute_script('return performance.timing.domContentLoadedEventEnd - performance.timing.navigationStart'); (8) collects driver.get_log('browser') and counts entries by level (SEVERE/WARNING/INFO). Report schema written to ui_probe_<UTC-isoformat>.json: {probe_ts_utc, target_url, http_status, security_headers, openapi_unauthed_status, dom_content_loaded_ms, browser_console: {SEVERE, WARNING, INFO}, screenshot_path, errors: [str]}. Wrap entire body in try/except - on failure write a report with errors populated and exit code 1. CLI: `python tower_selenium_ui_prober.py [--target URL] [--output-dir PATH]`. Default --target is the live URL. Default --output-dir on Windows is C:/Users/robin/ZoComputer/shared/outputs/probes (use forward slashes - Python handles them). Exits 0 on success, 1 on probe failure, 2 on bad CLI. NO FileHandler logging - script is short-lived; print to stdout. WHY NOW: this is the warm-compute use of the 32GB tower the May-7 update calls for. The probe consumer on ZoComputer already ingests JSON dropped at shared/outputs/probes/ - this is the missing producer for UI-level probes. Once it lands, ZoWarmWorker (bridge 7) can run it on a 5-min schedule and probe_consumer surfaces regressions automatically. CONSTRAINTS: Target tower (Windows + Selenium + Chrome). Selenium and requests imports only - no chromedriver_autoinstaller (assume Chrome and chromedriver are pre-installed). Headless ONLY. Always write a JSON report even on failure. NO FileHandler logging - script is short-lived. Idempotent - timestamp suffix means no overwrite. 30 second hard timeout per page-load.
